ayahs.2: Utaari hui hai bade Meharban bahut Rahm wale ki taraf se.
ayahs.3: (Aisi) kitaab hai jis ki aayaton ki waazeh tafseel ki gayi hai, (is haal mein ke) Quran Arabi zabaan mein hai us qaum ke liye jo jaanti hai.
ayahs.4: Khushkhabri sunaane wala aur daraane wala hai, phir bhi un ki aksariyat ne munh pher liya aur woh sunte hi nahin.
ayahs.5: Aur unhon ne kaha ke tu jis ki taraf hamein bula raha hai hamare dil to us se parde mein hain aur hamare kaanon mein girani hai aur hum mein aur tujh mein ek hijaab hai, achchha to ab apna kaam kiye ja hum bhi yaqeenan kaam karne wale hain.
ayahs.6: Aap keh dijiye! Ke main to tum hi jaisa insaan hoon, mujh par wahi naazil ki jaati hai ke tum sab ka mabood ek Allah hi hai, so tum us ki taraf mutawajjah ho jaao aur us se gunahon ki maafi chaaho, aur un mushrikon ke liye (badi hi) kharabi hai.
ayahs.7: Jo zakat nahin dete aur aakhirat ke bhi munkir hi rehte hain.
ayahs.8: Be-shak jo log imaan laaye aur bhale kaam karen un ke liye na khatm hone wala ajr hai.
ayahs.9: Aap keh dijiye! Ke kya tum us (Allah) ka inkaar karte ho aur tum us ke shareek muqarrar karte ho jis ne do din mein zameen paida kar di, saare jahaanon ka Parwardigaar wahi hai.
ayahs.10: Aur us ne zameen mein us ke oopar se pahaad gaad diye aur us mein barkat rakh di aur us mein (rehne walon ki) ghizaon ki tajweez bhi isi mein kar di (sirf) chaar din mein, zaroorat-mandon ke liye yaksaan taur par.
ayahs.11: Phir aasman ki taraf mutawajjah hua aur woh dhuaan (sa) tha, pas us se aur zameen se farmaaya ke tum donon khushi se aao ya na-khushi se, donon ne arz kiya hum ba-khushi haazir hain.
ayahs.12: Pas do din mein saat aasman bana diye aur har aasman mein us ke munaasib ahkaam ki wahi bhej di aur hum ne aasman-e-dunya ko chiraghon se zeenat di aur nigehbaani ki, yeh tadbeer Allah Ghaalib-o-Daana ki hai.
ayahs.13: Ab bhi yeh roogardaan hon to keh dijiye! Ke main tumhein us kadak (azaab-e-aasmani) se daraata hoon jo misl-e-Aadiyon aur Samoodiyon ki kadak hogi.
ayahs.14: Un ke paas jab un ke aage peechhe se Paighambar aaye ke tum Allah ke siwa kisi ki ibaadat na karo to unhon ne jawab diya ke agar hamara Parwardigaar chaahta to farishton ko bhejta. Hum to tumhari risalat ke bilkul munkir hain.
ayahs.15: Ab Aad ne to be-wajah zameen mein sarkashi shuru kar di aur kehne lage ke hum se zor-aawar kaun hai? Kya unhein yeh nazar na aaya ke jis ne unhein paida kiya hai woh un se (bahut hi) ziyada zor-aawar hai, woh (aakhir tak) hamari aayaton ka inkaar hi karte rahe.
ayahs.16: Bil-aakhir hum ne un par ek tez-o-tund aandhi manhoos dinon mein bhej di ke unhein dunyawi zindagi mein zillat ke azaab ka maza chakha den, aur (yaqeen maano) ke aakhirat ka azaab us se bahut ziyada ruswaai wala hai aur woh madad nahin kiye jaayenge.
ayahs.17: Rahe Samood, so hum ne un ki bhi rehberi ki, phir bhi unhon ne hidayat par andhe-pan ko tarjeeh di jis bina par unhein (sarapa) zillat ke azaab ki kadak ne un ke kartooton ke baais pakad liya.
ayahs.18: Aur (haan) imaan-daar aur parsaon ko hum ne (baal baal) bacha liya.
ayahs.19: Aur jis din Allah ke dushman dozakh ki taraf laaye jaayenge aur un (sab) ko jama kar diya jaayega.
ayahs.20: Yahan tak ke jab bilkul jahannam ke paas aa jaayenge aur un par un ke kaan aur un ki aankhen aur un ki khaalein un ke aamaal ki gawahi dengi.
ayahs.21: Yeh apni khaalon se kahenge ke tum ne hamare khilaaf shahadat kyun di? Woh jawab dengi ke hamein us Allah ne quwwat-e-goyaai ata farmaayi jis ne har cheez ko bolne ki taaqat bakhshi hai, isi ne tumhein awwal martaba paida kiya aur isi ki taraf tum sab lautaaye jaaoge.
ayahs.22: Aur tum (apni bad-amaliyan) is wajah se posheeda rakhte hi na the ke tum par tumhare kaan aur tumhari aankhen aur tumhari khaalein gawahi dengi, haan tum yeh samajhte rahe ke tum jo kuchh bhi kar rahe ho us mein se bahut se aamaal se Allah be-khabar hai.
ayahs.23: Tumhari isi bad-gumani ne jo tum ne apne Rabb se kar rakhi thi tumhein halaak kar diya aur bil-aakhir tum ziyan-karon mein ho gaye.
ayahs.24: Ab agar yeh sabr karen to bhi un ka thikaana jahannam hi hai. Aur agar yeh (uzr aur) maafi ke khwastagaar hon to bhi (mazoor aur) maaf nahin rakhe jaayenge.
ayahs.25: Aur hum ne un ke kuchh hum-nasheen muqarrar kar rakhe the, jinhon ne un ke agle pichhle aamaal un ki nigaahon mein khoobsurat bana rakhe the aur un ke haq mein bhi Allah ka qaul un ummaton ke saath poora hua jo un se pehle jinon insaanon ki guzar chuki hain. Yaqeenan woh ziyan-kar saabit hue.
ayahs.26: Aur kaafiron ne kaha is Quran ko suno hi mat (is ke padhe jaane ke waqt) aur behuda-goi karo, kya ajab ke tum ghaalib aa jaao.
ayahs.27: Pas yaqeenan hum un kaafiron ko sakht azaab ka maza chakhayenge. Aur unhein un ke badtareen aamaal ka badla (zaroor) zaroor denge.
ayahs.28: Allah ke dushmanon ki saza yehi dozakh ki aag hai jis mein un ka hameshgi ka ghar hai, (yeh) badla hai hamari aayaton se inkaar karne ka.
ayahs.29: Aur kaafir log kahenge ae hamare Rabb! Hamein jinon insaanon (ke woh donon fareeq) dikha jinhon ne hamein gumraah kiya (taake) hum unhein apne qadmon tale daal den taake woh jahannam mein sab se neeche (sakht azaab mein) ho jaayen.
ayahs.30: (Waqai) jin logon ne kaha ke hamara Parwardigaar Allah hai phir isi par qaayim rahe un ke paas farishte (yeh kehte hue) aate hain ke tum kuchh bhi andesha aur gham na karo (balke) us jannat ki basharat sun lo jis ka tum waada diye gaye ho.
ayahs.31: Tumhari dunyawi zindagi mein bhi hum tumhare rafeeq the aur aakhirat mein bhi rahenge, jis cheez ko tumhara ji chaahe aur jo kuchh tum maango sab tumhare liye (jannat mein maujood) hai.
ayahs.32: Ghafoor-o-Raheem (mabood) ki taraf se yeh sab kuchh ba-taur-e-mehmaani ke hai.
ayahs.33: Aur us se ziyada achchhi baat wala kaun hai jo Allah ki taraf bulaaye aur nek kaam kare aur kahe ke main yaqeenan musalmanon mein se hoon.
ayahs.34: Neki aur badi baraabar nahin hoti. Buraai ko bhalai se dafa karo phir wohi jis ke aur tumhare darmiyaan dushmani hai aisa ho jaayega jaise dili dost.
ayahs.35: Aur yeh baat unhi ko naseeb hoti hai jo sabr karen aur ise siwaaye bade naseebe walon ke koi nahin paa sakta.
ayahs.36: Aur agar shaitaan ki taraf se koi waswasa aaye to Allah ki panaah talab karo, yaqeenan woh bahut hi sunne wala aur jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.37: Aur din raat aur sooraj chaand bhi (isi ki) nishaniyon mein se hain, tum sooraj ko sajda na karo na chaand ko balke sajda us Allah ke liye karo jis ne un sab ko paida kiya hai, agar tumhein us ki ibaadat karni hai to.
ayahs.38: Phir bhi agar yeh kibr-o-ghuroor karen to woh (farishte) jo aap ke Rabb ke nazdeek hain woh to raat din us ki tasbeeh bayan kar rahe hain aur (kisi waqt bhi) nahin uktaate.
ayahs.39: Us Allah ki nishaniyon mein se (yeh bhi) hai ke tu zameen ko dabi dabayi dekhta hai phir jab hum us par meenh barsaate hain to woh tar-o-taza ho kar ubharne lagti hai, jis ne ise zinda kiya wohi yaqeeni taur par murdon ko bhi zinda karne wala hai, be-shak woh har (har) cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.40: Be-shak jo log hamari aayaton mein kaj-rawi karte hain woh (kuchh) hum se makhfi nahin, (batlaao to) jo aag mein daala jaaye woh achchha hai ya woh jo aman-o-amaan ke saath qayamat ke din aaye? Tum jo chaaho karte chale jaao woh tumhara sab kiya karaya dekh raha hai.
ayahs.41: Jin logon ne apne paas Quran pahunch jaane ke bawajood us se kufr kiya, (woh bhi hum se posheeda nahin) yeh badi ba-waqaat kitaab hai.
ayahs.42: Jis ke paas baatil phatak bhi nahin sakta na us ke aage se na us ke peechhe se, yeh hai naazil-karda hikmaton wale khoobiyon wale (Allah) ki taraf se.
ayahs.43: Aap se wohi kaha jaata hai jo aap se pehle ke Rasoolon se bhi kaha gaya hai, yaqeenan aap ka Rabb maafi wala aur dardnaak azaab wala hai.
ayahs.44: Aur agar hum ise ajami zabaan ka Quran banaate to kehte ke is ki aayaten saaf saaf bayan kyun nahin ki gayin? Yeh kya ke ajami kitaab aur aap Arabi Rasool? Aap keh dijiye! Ke yeh to imaan walon ke liye hidayat-o-shifa hai aur jo imaan nahin laate un ke kaanon mein to (behrapan aur) bojh hai aur yeh un par andhapan hai, yeh woh log hain jo kisi bahut door-daraaz jagah se pukaare ja rahe hain.
ayahs.45: Yaqeenan hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko kitaab di thi, so us mein bhi ikhtilaaf kiya gaya aur agar (woh) baat na hoti (jo) aap ke Rabb ki taraf se pehle hi muqarrar ho chuki hai, to un ke darmiyaan (kabhi ka) faisla ho chuka hota, yeh log to us ke baare mein sakht be-chain karne wale shak mein hain.
ayahs.46: Jo shakhs nek kaam karega woh apne nafa ke liye aur jo bura kaam karega us ka wabaal isi par hai. Aur aap ka Rabb bandon par zulm karne wala nahin.
ayahs.47: Qayamat ka ilm Allah hi ki taraf lautaaya jaata hai aur jo jo phal apne shagoofon mein se nikalte hain aur jo maada-e-haml se hoti hai aur jo bachche woh janti hai sab ka ilm use hai aur jis din Allah Taala un (mushrikon) ko bula kar daryaaft farmaayega mere shareek kahan hain, woh jawab denge ke hum ne to tujhe keh sunaaya ke hum mein se to koi us ka gawah nahin.
ayahs.48: Aur yeh jin (jin) ki parastish us se pehle karte the woh un ki nigah se gum ho gaye aur unhon ne samajh liya ke ab un ke liye koi bachaao nahin.
ayahs.49: Bhalai ke maangne se insaan thakta nahin aur agar use koi takleef pahunch jaaye to maayoos aur na-umeed ho jaata hai.
ayahs.50: Aur jo museebat use pahunch chuki hai us ke baad agar hum use kisi rehmat ka maza chakhayen to woh keh uthta hai ke is ka to main haq-daar hi tha aur main to khayaal nahin kar sakta ke qayamat qaayim hogi aur agar main apne Rabb ke paas wapas kiya gaya to bhi yaqeenan mere liye us ke paas bhi behtari hai, yaqeenan hum in kuffar ko un ke aamaal se khabardaar karenge aur unhein sakht azaab ka maza chakhayenge.
ayahs.51: Aur jab hum insaan par apna inaam karte hain to woh munh pher leta hai aur kinara-kash ho jaata hai aur jab use museebat padti hai to badi lambi-chaudi duaayen karne wala ban jaata hai.
ayahs.52: Aap keh dijiye! Ke bhala yeh to bataao ke agar yeh Quran Allah ki taraf se aaya hua ho phir tum ne ise na maana, bas is se badh kar behka hua kaun hoga jo mukhalifat mein (haq se) door chala jaaye.
ayahs.53: Anqareeb hum unhein apni nishaniyan aafaaq-e-aalam mein bhi dikhayenge aur khud un ki apni zaat mein bhi yahan tak ke un par khul jaaye ke haq yehi hai, kya aap ke Rabb ka har cheez se waaqif-o-aagaah hona kaafi nahin.
ayahs.54: Yaqeen jaano! Ke yeh log apne Rabb ke roo-ba-roo jaane se shak mein hain, yaad rakho ke Allah Taala har cheez ka ihaata kiye hue hai.
